skill.summary: Tests and debugs webhooks. Inspects requests and validates responses. Triggers: test webhook, webhook debug, http webhook.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the webhook testing and debugging tool.

- Supports testing and debugging of webhook integrations.
- Inspects incoming webhook requests and validates responses.
- Provides sample test payloads and response code details.
- Includes references to common webhook testing tools.
